text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike on /v1/generate and rising 5xx across gateway. Started 5619876520. Affected region: us-west-2. Deploy at 5619876000 suspected. Paging oncall.

tara: looking. I’m oncall — will triage. @ken can you grab traces? :pager:

ken: seeing p95 jump from 120ms -> 1.8s, p99 ~ 4.2s. 5xx rate up to 3.2% overall, gateways showing 504/502 mix.

maya: logs show increased backend tail latency on model-host-12 and -13. Errors: "context deadline exceeded" and client conn resets. Rolling windows align with canary rollout timestamp.

tara: ok, can we cut traffic to the new canary variant? runbook step 1.

ken: trying route-shift now — shifting 100% canary -> baseline for the service.

```bash
# shift traffic to stable
redwood route shift --service text-gen --from canary-2026-03-15 --to stable-v3 --percent 100
```

deploy-bot: @tara route shift command accepted, initiating. Progress: 25% -> 50% -> 100%.

tara: monitoring metrics.

ken: after shift, p95 dropped to 320ms but p99 still ~1.1s and some timeouts persist. Suggest immediate rollback of the deploy (canary). If traffic shift didn't remove all, rollback.

maya: reproducer: send a longer context payload and you'll see stall at kvcache eviction logs. Example:

```json
{"prompt":"<long conversation>...","max_tokens":1024}
```

ken: looks like the new release changed kv cache eviction policy and increased stall on certain seq lengths. Runbook suggests revert.

jules: customer-impact: we have alarms from 12 high-tier tenants and a few internal dashboards reporting elevated errors. Ops impact: degraded latency for webapps, some streaming sessions aborted. I'll open an Incident on status page and ping sales for heads-up.

tara: go ahead jules. Ken, initiate rollback. I’ll coordinate page and SRE.

env note: we do not have a hotfix that avoids regression.

ken: executing rollback now.

```bash
# rollback to previous stable version
deploy-bot rollback --service text-gen --to stable-v2 --reason "post-deploy p99/timeouts"
```

deploy-bot: rollback job started (job id: rb-5619876600). Estimated 3m. Notifying schedulers and health checks.

tara: pushing extended timeouts on gateway as short mitigation while rollback completes: increased upstream timeout to 30s for /v1/generate.

maya: ack, applying timeout change.

ken: rollback finished. deploy-bot: rb-5619876600 -> success. Can confirm versions now at stable-v2 on all hosts.

deploy-bot: rollout complete. All instances reporting stable-v2.

tara: metrics update — p95 down to 150ms, p99 back to ~220ms. 5xx rate returning to baseline (0.1%). Monitoring for 10m.

jules: status page update posted: "Partial service degradation in us-west-2, mitigated. Customers may have experienced timeouts. Root cause investigation underway." Sent to #customers-ops.

ken: collecting traces/logs for postmortem. Saved sample traces and KV eviction trace window: trace ids: [tr-5619876591, tr-5619876592].

maya: attaching minimal repro and the diff that caused kv policy change to our internal PR: PR#4821. Will link in postmortem.

tara: oncall handoff: I’ll stay till postmortem triage done. Ken, can you own RCA writeup? Maya, own code fix if needed. Jules to handle customer comms and severity review.

jules: noted. Severity set to SEV2 given partial customer impact.

tara: thanks all. Closing this thread after 10m stable window. Reminder: do a canary smaller next time and include kv eviction perf tests in canary suite. :memo:

incident-bot: Incident resolved at 5619876625. Follow-up tasks: add kv eviction to canary tests, improve early-warning alerts for p99 drift, postmortem assigned to ken/maya/jules.
